prepare_change.comparison: Current file differs from HEAD only by the one CurrentChen adoption attempt directory argument.

checks.detail: Reviewed temporary helper outside the old worktree uses frozen old protocol modules through PYTHONPATH. Original HEAD and attempt-001 are retained until successful capture and independent output preservation; no fetch or checkout first.

checks.item: two independent SHA anchors and CLI
checks.detail: capture/rebind arguments match argparse. Both --original-records-sha256 and --capture-manifest-sha256 are mandatory; stdout exposes registry_sha256 and capture_manifest_sha256. Documentation leaves real values unknown and forbids self-anchoring from candidate files.

Native attempt-002 uses the original Winner9 qualifications/attempt-003 snapshot, not stale P2.7 attempt-001. CurrentChen adoption uses the new snapshot and adoption/attempt-002; outputs must be new and successful phases are not rerun.

checks.item: three checked sources and two writes
checks.detail: MODULES has three original strict compilations; REBOUND_MODULES contains Bridge and FullBuchstab only. PairedV2 remains schema 2. Protected project union has 13 modules including the three targets. No new Lean invocation or object modification is claimed.
Document explicitly requires idle writers for the same worktree, serial Bash stages, set -euo pipefail, and stop on failure. It does not describe byte comparisons as an interprocess lock.

checks.item: original evidence included by unchanged exporter
checks.detail: Rebind output lies under .lake/p2-private/native-record-migration/attempt-002. Existing exporter supplements include JSON and .log paths containing migration, excluding audit/lib/exports/native-cache components; original registry/snapshot/capture/receipt JSON and COMPILE_LOG.*.log copies meet these rules. Actual exported members must still be checked.

Existing checker and audit CLI parameters, memory choices and external snapshot path match. The 26-line target list is used in full. Existing numeric audit snapshots omit external context when no native ancestor is required, so valid 19 receipts can be reused; the document requires observed REUSE/REUSE_AUDIT rather than predicted success.

Exporter output-dir/split/transfer-page-bytes/driver-file/extra-evidence parameters match. Both documented historical driver hashes match exporter constants. One original export precedes delta packing; exact acceptance counts and source identities remain runtime gates.

checks.item: delta attempt and sole packaging entry
checks.detail: prepare changes only the CurrentChen adoption argument from attempt-001 to attempt-002. next-private-step.sh 0 is the sole initial packaging/page-0 entry; later pages read the existing archive. Document prohibits prior standalone prepare plus page 0, and prohibits blindly rerunning page 0 after packaging succeeds.

Original exporter manifest SHA must be independently retained and compared. Delta verification re-reads fixed Git references and embedded bytes; documentation retains 26 audits, 81 source contexts and seven Completion theorem types as final evidence requirements, without extending completion to P5 or the whole project.

addressed_findings.finding: Idle writer precondition was absent from the initial document.
addressed_findings.resolution: Root added same-worktree writer exclusion and the distinction between byte checks and process locking.

addressed_findings.finding: Commands using mapfile were initially labeled sh without an explicit fail-stop shell setup.
addressed_findings.resolution: Root made every executable block Bash with set -euo pipefail and serial stage instructions.

addressed_findings.finding: Standalone prepare followed by next-private-step page 0 would package twice and fail on the existing delivery directory.
addressed_findings.resolution: Root made page 0 the sole packaging entry and documented read-only later pages and existing-package recovery.

addressed_findings.finding: The initial 13-ancestor wording could exclude the three roots from the stated count.
addressed_findings.resolution: Root clarified a 13-module protected closure including the three target modules.

runtime_limitations.note: This review checks command contracts and documentation, not runtime feasibility, original provider sufficiency or actual proof acceptance. P2 runtime SHA anchors and successful capture/rebind remain pending.
